name: Init
description: Laying down an empty specification to start a reference line from.

scenarios.title: The first run lays down what a reference line starts from
scenarios.then: an empty glossary specification is created at the configured root

scenarios.title: A second run leaves the reference line alone
given: a directory `sumi init` has already run in
scenarios.then: each specification is reported as already there rather than replaced

scenarios.title: A configured root is created however deep it is
given: a .sumi.json naming a root two directories down
scenarios.then: every directory on the way to that root is created

scenarios.title: The first run lays down somewhere for behaviors to go
scenarios.then: a behavior directory is created at the configured root
